problem:
$$
f(y,z)=⟨\text{___},\,y,\,z⟩
$$

The vector-valued function $f(y,z)$ above parametrizes the parabolic cylinder defined in Cartesian coordinates as $8{z}^{2}=x.$ What is the first component of $f?$
worked_solution:
For any point $(x,y,z)$ on our surface, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(y,z) & =⟨x,y,z⟩ \\  & =⟨8{z}^{2},\,y,\,z⟩\end{aligned}
$$

where $y\in (-\infty ,\infty )$ and $z\in (-\infty ,\infty ).$

Therefore, the first component of $f$ is $8{z}^{2}.$
